# UpGuard

> UpGuard is a cybersecurity platform that helps organizations manage and reduce their cyber risk through an integrated platform. It offers solutions for third-party risk management, attack surface management, and external threat intelligence, leveraging AI for comprehensive risk analysis and reporting.
>
> UpGuard's platform provides continuous monitoring, automated assessments, and threat monitoring to give businesses a unified score of their security posture. It helps prevent data breaches, streamline third-party assessments, vendor assessments, and proactively identify vulnerabilities across their digital assets and vendors.

## Product Overviews

- [UpGuard Breach Risk: Attack Surface Management and Threat Monitoring](https://www.upguard.com/product/breach-risk): Real-time attack surface management with external threat monitoring across open, deep, and dark web sources.
- [UpGuard Vendor Risk: Third-Party Risk Management](https://www.upguard.com/product/vendorrisk): Comprehensive third-party/vendor risk management with security ratings and automated questionnaires.
- [UpGuard Trust Exchange: Trust Management](https://www.upguard.com/product/trust-exchange): AI-powered questionnaire automation and trust center tools, enabling sales and security teams to automate the questionnaire processes and share your security posture with customers.
